stories.title: Driverless cars to be tested in Ras Al Khaimah communities
stories.summary: The Ras Al Khaimah Transport Authority and RAK Properties announced a partnership to test autonomous vehicles in residential communities and mixed-use developments at Mina. The trials aim to assess vehicle performance, safety, and readiness for potential deployment across the emirate under real-world urban conditions.

stories.title: Euronaval 2026 – Manned brain, unmanned muscle: ST Engineering’s MRV makes its European debut
stories.summary: ST Engineering presented a scale model of its 150-meter Multi-Role Vessel at Euronaval 2026 in Paris, proposing a manned mothership to coordinate unmanned surface vessels. The 8,000-tonne platform features MBDA MICA and Aster missiles, a Leonardo 76 mm Strales gun, and a 30 mm MK30-C30 weapon system.

stories.title: STB orders Union Pacific to make alleged rate hike threat video public
stories.summary: The Surface Transportation Board ordered Union Pacific to make public a recording of Chief Executive Jim Vena’s remarks to a shipper conference, rejecting the railroad’s appeal in a dispute over whether he threatened customers who oppose its proposed acquisition of Norfolk Southern.

stories.title: Tesla wants its sworn Cybercab answers to NHTSA kept entirely secret
stories.summary: Tesla answered NHTSA’s Special Order demanding it prove, under oath, that the Cybercab meets federal safety standards. The response landed on the October 30 deadline, and Tesla asked the agency to keep all of it confidential.

also.title: Tesla Responds, But Keeps Cybercab Certification Answers Confidential in NHTSA Safety Audit
Tesla asked to classify its response to NHTSA on Cybercab safety — Electrek

stories.title: Zelensky invites Ibero-American Summit countries to join Drone Deal cooperation format
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky invited countries participating in the Ibero-American Summit to cooperate with Ukraine under the Drone Deal format, including through joint drone production and technology sharing. He made the statement during a special panel on Ukraine at the 30th Ibero-American Summit in Madrid.

stories.title: Boeing advances drone-based inspections for C-17 aircraft
stories.summary: Boeing is advancing its Advanced Aircraft Inspection program at its San Antonio site, combining autonomous drones with Automated Damage Detection Software to inspect C-17 Globemaster III aircraft. The system captures exterior images and identifies anomalies to reduce reliance on manual lift equipment, improve inspection consistency, and support fleet availability.

stories.title: Naval Group highlights drone-based mine warfare capabilities
stories.summary: Naval Group stated that its mine warfare vessels use aerial, surface, and underwater drones to conduct remote mine countermeasure operations while keeping ships and crews at a safer distance from potential threats. The company said its modular approach, used in the Belgian-Dutch rMCM programme, enables remote mine detection, classification, and clearance.

stories.title: Houthis claim drone attack on Dammam airport
stories.summary: Yemen’s Houthi forces claimed responsibility for a drone attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, on Thursday, November 5, alleging the operation disrupted air traffic. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree announced the claim on X, stating the operation achieved its objective, while Saudi authorities had not immediately commented.

stories.title: Army Puts Overland AI’s ULTRA Ground Robot Through Its Paces
stories.summary: The Marine Corps awarded Overland AI a $19.7 million production agreement for more than a dozen autonomous ground vehicles, with initial deliveries expected in early 2027. The contract makes Overland AI the first ground-autonomy company to serve as prime contractor on a military production agreement.

stories.title: Your Robotaxi Is Watching You. Does the Fourth Amendment Care?
stories.summary: Waymo stopped a driverless taxi in San Francisco on September 3, 2026, after detecting a firearm, leading police to detain two passengers and seize a loaded AR-style rifle. The company alerted emergency services and generated data for officers, actions that do not trigger Fourth Amendment protections against private actors.

stories.title: France Is Making a Big New Investment in Naval Drones. Here’s What It’s Buying.
stories.summary: French Minister of the Armed Forces Catherine Vautrin announced a new government-industry initiative at the Euronaval defense exhibition to accelerate the development and production of naval drones. France plans to purchase eight Exail A18 mine-countermeasure drones, a second LD Travocean ROV Deep Sea system, and a second Naval Group unmanned combat underwater vehicle.

stories.title: How Ambi Robotics helps its customers prepare for peak season
stories.summary: Ambi Robotics is installing new systems at eight facilities before peak season, expecting customers to see a 9% to 10% increase in throughput. The company is also forward-deploying spare parts to specific locations in the East Coast that are hubs of customer activity.

stories.title: Amazon’s Zoox Plans Robotaxi Testing Expansion Into Europe and Asia
stories.summary: Amazon-owned Zoox announced plans to expand autonomous vehicle testing into Europe and Asia, identifying London, other European Union cities, South Korea, and Japan as potential markets. The company will initially deploy modified Toyota Highlander SUVs to collect data on local roads and traffic conditions before introducing its purpose-built robotaxis.

stories.title: Zoox Brings Autonomous Ride-Hailing to Formula 1’s Las Vegas Future
stories.summary: Zoox announced a multi-year partnership with Las Vegas Grand Prix, Inc. to become the official autonomous ride-hail partner of the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix. Beginning in 2027, the company plans to offer rides in its purpose-built robotaxis to and from Grand Prix Plaza, featuring a dedicated pickup and drop-off location near Formula 1’s Las Vegas hub.

stories.title: Unidentified UAV Resembling Russian Gerbera Drone Found in Moldova
stories.summary: Moldovan Police discovered an unidentified drone near the village of Gordinești in the Reșița district, which they believe is likely a Russian Gerbera strike UAV. Specialists from the police’s technical and explosive ordnance disposal unit were dispatched to examine the object found in a forested area to determine its type and origin.

stories.title: Kraken Robotics Announces $102M In New Orders
stories.summary: Kraken Robotics Inc. announced $102 million in new orders since Aug. 27, 2026, bringing its 2026 total to approximately $457 million. Over 60 per cent of these combined orders came from defence industry customers, with the vast majority expected to convert to revenue within the next 12 months.

stories.title: Chinese regulators block SoftBank’s $5.4B acquisition of ABB Robotics
stories.summary: China’s Office of the Working Mechanism for Foreign Investment Security Review prohibited SoftBank Group’s $5.375 billion acquisition of ABB Robotics, citing concerns about robotics data being transferred overseas to train AI models. ABB and SoftBank stated they are in close dialogue and working constructively on the transaction.

also.title: China blocks SoftBank’s US$5.37bn bid for ABB Robotics

stories.title: Researcher Maps Where Tesla Robotaxis Can Actually Pick Up Passengers
stories.summary: Independent researcher Koby Pierce mapped Tesla Robotaxi service areas in Texas and found actual pickup zones are smaller than advertised, with Austin's usable area approximately 41% smaller and Dallas covering 78% of its advertised land. Pierce plans to analyze Miami, Orlando, and Tampa next.

stories.title: US Army Demonstrates 3D-Printed Hybrid Engine for Advanced UAS
stories.summary: The Army Research Laboratory demonstrated a 3D-printed heavy-fuel rotary engine powering the VICTOR Group 3 unmanned aircraft system in flight testing near Huntsville, Alabama. The series-hybrid system, integrated with a 400-volt motor-generator, supports vertical takeoff and landing operations and aims to extend UAS range and payload capacity.

stories.title: Russia Launches Nearly 8,000 Molniya and Lancet Drones in One Week, Ukraine Neutralizes 91%
stories.summary: Russian forces deployed 7,947 Molniya and Lancet drones between October 29 and November 4, with Ukrainian forces neutralizing 7,225 of them. The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported an average of more than 1,100 drones per day, peaking at 1,609 Molniya drones on October 30.

stories.title: Seattle light rail extension consultation to begin in December
stories.summary: Sound Transit and the Federal Transit Administration will publish a draft environmental impact statement for the Ballard Link Extension on December 11, seeking public feedback by February 9, 2027. The 12.4 km branch off the 1 Line includes a 5.3 km tunnel and up to nine stops, with opening envisaged for 2042.

also.title: Sound Transit, FTA to Release Ballard Link Extension Draft EIS

stories.title: A 6,000-pound drone helicopter the Navy was trucking to the Arizona boneyard is flying again over Utah with Army sensors bolted on, after the Army asked for four of them, two years after the Navy decided a drone a hundredth of the price could do its job
French company Kahe Nautic launches low-cost K600 semi-submersible drone for more than 65 maritime missions
stories.summary: French manufacturer Kahe Nautic unveiled its €5,900 K600 semi-submersible drone at Euronaval 2026 in Paris, introducing a 15 kg unmanned vehicle engineered for over 65 maritime applications. The company targets a 300-unit pre-series production and Technology Readiness Level 7 qualification by September 2027.

stories.title: How a new UAV with a "Sausage" paralyzes the air defense of Ukraine
stories.summary: The Gastello Design Bureau developed a foam blende UAV modification nicknamed "Sausage," which uses an automatic video processing unit to detect Ukrainian FPV interceptors and trigger emergency maneuvers. This system aims to force enemy air defense to waste resources on invulnerable targets, thereby reducing the Armed Forces of Ukraine's ability to resist in the air by the start of the winter campaign.

stories.title: Brazilian Air Taxi Group FlyBis Confirms eVTOL Orders
stories.summary: Brazilian air taxi start-up FlyBis signed a contract for up to 12 of Eve Air Mobility’s eVTOL aircraft, covering two firm orders and purchase rights for 10 more. The operator intends to use the Eve-100 aircraft for services in southern Brazil, connecting areas such as Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.

also.title: FlyBIS signs a deal with Eve for up to 12 eVTOL aircraft to fly in southern Brazil
Eve signs binding agreement for up to 12 eVTOLs with aspiring Brazilian operator
Eve Air Mobility and FlyBIS Sign Binding Agreement for Up to 12 eVTOLs in Southern Brazil

stories.title: ORIGIN and Anduril demonstrate integrated counter-UAS capability in Latvia
stories.summary: Latvian defence technology company ORIGIN and US defence technology company Anduril demonstrated an integrated counter-unmanned aircraft system capability to senior Latvian military leadership in late October. The system combined ORIGIN’s BLAZE interceptor with Anduril’s Lattice command-and-control platform, with technical integration taking four days.

also.title: Origin and Anduril put joint counter-drone system through its first test in Latvia

stories.title: Tesla brings production Cybercab and more to China import expo in Shanghai
stories.summary: Tesla is displaying a production Cybercab at the China International Import Expo in Shanghai, which runs Nov 5–10. The two-seat robotaxi joins the Model Y Performance and Optimus humanoid robot in Tesla’s Hall 3H exhibition area, following a prior display at Shanghai’s Oriental Pearl Tower from Oct 29 to Nov 1.

stories.title: Russian Phishing Drones Target Kyiv With Malware QR-Codes in Pro-Ukraine Pamphlets
stories.summary: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces shot down a Russian Shahed drone near Kyiv that carried propaganda leaflets with QR codes designed to phish finders' identities and locations. The statement warned that scanning the codes sends data to Russian intelligence, a tactic Ukraine first detected in early 2025.

also.title: Russians launch propaganda Shahed drone to drop leaflets on Kyiv

stories.title: Valhalla Turrets Completes Trials of ASGARD Counter-Drone Turret Equipped with M134D 7.62 mm Gatling Gun
stories.summary: Slovenia’s Valhalla Turrets completed live-fire trials of its ASGARD counter-drone turret, which is armed with a Dillon Aero M134D 7.62 mm Gatling gun. Supported by the Slovenian Armed Forces, the tests involved firing thousands of rounds to assess the mobile system’s ability to protect military convoys and critical infrastructure against low-flying drones.

stories.title: ENAIRE showcases in Benidorm how U-space will shape the future of drone operations
stories.summary: ENAIRE, Benidorm City Council, and Universitat Politècnica de València held a technical event at Benidorm City Hall to demonstrate U-space services for drone operations. The session included a digital platform simulation of flight-plan activation and automated alert management, following Benidorm's February 2025 first simultaneous operation of an unmanned air taxi and multiple drones in Europe.

stories.title: US awards USD6.9 million contract for counter-UAS radars in CENTCOM region
stories.summary: The US Department of War awarded CHAOS 1, Inc. a contract worth more than USD 6.9 million on 4 November for Vanquish Prime radar systems. Joint Interagency Task Force 401 will use the systems to detect and track uncrewed aircraft in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

also.title: Radar Contract Boosts USCENTCOM Counter-Drone Defense

stories.title: HII, Thales Link Underwater Drone and Mine Neutralization Systems
stories.summary: HII and Thales demonstrated a mine countermeasure system that integrates an autonomous underwater search vehicle, AI-assisted sonar analysis, and remotely operated equipment to identify and neutralize mines. The companies stated that integrating these systems shortened the operational timeline and allowed personnel and crewed platforms to remain farther from potential mines.

stories.title: WSDOT seeks public input on early stages of high-speed rail from Vancouver, BC to Portland
stories.summary: The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is seeking public input on the Cascadia High-Speed Rail, a proposed 377-mile corridor connecting Vancouver, BC, Seattle, and Portland. WSDOT received a $49.7 million Federal Railroad Administration grant and a $5.5 million state match to complete a Service Development Plan by 2028, with an online survey open until Nov. 13.

also.title: WSDOT wants public input on proposed high-speed rail connecting Seattle, Portland, and Vancouver -

stories.title: ABB Robotics and NVIDIA launch physical AI education program
stories.summary: ABB Robotics developed an education program with NVIDIA AI technologies focused on physical AI and related skills for industrial applications. The program will include hands-on learning with ABB RobotStudio and NVIDIA Omniverse and will offer a certificate in robotics, simulation and physical AI after completion.

stories.title: Renault Enters the Robot War With a Lunar-Style Military Rover That Carries a Ton and Mounts a Gun
stories.summary: Renault and John Cockerill unveiled Forefront, a driverless military vehicle capable of hauling one metric ton and mounting weapons, on November 3. The platform uses electric motors to travel 400 kilometers and can be dropped by helicopter, with France’s armed forces expected to test it in the coming weeks.

also.title: Renault develops 400-km ground robot designed for dangerous military missions

stories.title: Forterra and May Mobility Advance to Phase III of DIU’s ROADS Challenge, Bringing Autonomous Rides to Soldiers on Military Bases
stories.summary: Forterra and May Mobility were selected by the Department of War Innovation Unit to advance to Phase III of the ROADS challenge, an up to $30 million effort to test commercial self-driving vehicles on military bases. Vendor mapping begins in November, with a month-long pilot planned at Fort Benning by the end of 2026.

also.title: May Mobility robotaxis head for Army bases with Forterra

stories.title: AutoFlight Completes World-First Five-eVTOL Autonomous Formation Flight
stories.summary: AutoFlight completed a 47-minute autonomous formation flight of five eVTOL aircraft, including one five-ton V5000 Matrix and four two-ton models, at its Bailian Lake base in Kunshan, China. The demonstration, conducted on October 31 and November 1, featured the lead aircraft traveling more than 133 kilometers without manual intervention.

also.title: World’s First: AutoFlight Nails a 5-eVTOL Autonomous Formation Flight in China

stories.title: ID Logistics and Terra Robotics plan humanoid robot pilot in Germany
stories.summary: ID Logistics and Terra Robotics plan to launch their first humanoid robot pilot in Germany within six months to assess capabilities under real operating conditions. The partnership, effective 1 November 2026, follows initial tests with two Unitree G1 EDU6 robots at facilities in Griesheim and Löhne.

also.title: ID Logistics to test a humanoid robot at a site in Germany within six months

stories.title: Tanzania seeks investors for standard gauge projects
stories.summary: Tanzania Railway Corp is seeking private partners to construct and operate two 1 000 km freight railway corridors serving the north and south of the country. The agency is also planning to buy 34 electric locomotives, 1 000 freight wagons, and 60 passenger coaches, with procurements funded by the state government.

stories.title: A former Apple and Uber engineer raised $51 million to rethink the self-driving truck
stories.summary: San Francisco startup Humble raised $51 million to build electric self-driving trucks without drivers' cabs, bringing its total funding to $75 million. The company plans to begin customer pilots in the first quarter of 2027 and expects commercial operations to start in the third quarter of 2027.

also.title: Humble Robotics Raises $51 Million for Cabless Self-Driving Trucks
Humble Robotics Raises $51M for Cabless Truck [2026]
Humble Robotics raises $51M for cabless hauler pilots
Humble Robotics Raises $51M Series A for Driverless Electric Freight Trucks Built From Scratch

stories.title: Israeli defense company says this trigger is programmed to shoot drones
stories.summary: Thailand’s Ministry of Defence began fielding a new computerized rifle trigger designed to help soldiers shoot down small drones, according to last month’s announcement by the device’s manufacturer, Israel Weapon Industries, or IWI. Company officials consider the deployment a real-world endorsement of the Arbel Anti-Drone System as a potential solution for countering drones on the battlefield.

stories.title: DJI Launches Matrice 5T with Advanced Thermal Imaging, AI, and Longer Flight Time
stories.summary: DJI launched the Matrice 5T enterprise drone on November 5, 2026, featuring 59 minutes of flight time and thermal imaging with 1280 × 1024 resolution. The aircraft supports centimeter-level surveying and obstacle detection via LiDAR, but U.S. availability remains unconfirmed following the Federal Communications Commission’s December 2025 decision to add foreign-produced drones to its Covered List.

also.title: DJI Matrice 5T Puts 1K Thermal in a Folding Drone the US Can't Buy

stories.title: Toyota sets up robot unit as carmakers push new technology
stories.summary: Toyota established a dedicated robotics department led by chief production officer Takefumi Shiga to accelerate commercialization and deployment. The company also raised its annual operating profit forecast 15% to 3.9 trillion yen and plans a new Shanghai factory producing Lexus EVs beginning in late 2027.

also.title: Toyota advances robotics with new division

stories.title: US Army Tests Anduril's Heimdal Counter-Drone Sensor on Southern Border
French counter-drone startup Alta Ares wins third of NATO framework contract
stories.summary: French startup Alta Ares won six of 16 lots under a NATO framework contract for counter-drone systems, its largest contract to date. The company aims to produce more than 1,000 interceptors a month by 2027.

also.title: NATO Picks France's Alta Ares Counter-Drone Systems to Protect Troops and Bases From Drone Attacks

stories.title: Port KC’s Riverfront Rail Crossing Project Awarded $72MM
stories.summary: The FRA awarded up to $72 million for the riverfront rail crossing elimination project located at Lydia Avenue in Kansas City. Port KC says it will coordinate 20% non-federal cost share funding, and the project design and planning work will begin immediately.

stories.title: Zipline Raises $1.5 Billion – with a B – to Expand Drone Delivery Across the U.S.
stories.summary: Zipline raised $1.5 billion to expand its U.S. operations, valuing the company at $21.5 billion. The funding supports manufacturing, hiring, and delivery infrastructure, with plans to launch 300 additional Walmart delivery sites and reach one million daily drone deliveries by the end of 2029.

also.title: Zipline Raises $1.5 Billion as Walmart Signs for 300 More Drone Sites
Zipline Raises $1.5 Billion to Build Nationwide Drone Delivery Network
Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
Walmart Adds 300 Zipline Drone Delivery Sites Nationwide After $1.5B Funding Round
Zipline Lands $1.5 Billion, Teams With Walmart for 300 New Drone Delivery Sites
Axon Invests $1.2 Billion in Skydio to Build the Future of Drone as First Responder
Zipline raises $1.5B at $21.5B valuation to test drone delivery at scale
Zipline Valuation Hits $21.5B After $1.5B Raise [2026]
Walmart and Zipline enter multi-year agreement to expand drone delivery nationwide
Walmart expands drone delivery with 300 Zipline locations

stories.title: Broward Commuter Rail South Advances to Engineering Phase
stories.summary: The Federal Transit Administration advanced Broward Commuter Rail South into the Engineering phase and identified $164 million in anticipated funding. The 10.5-mile project, which includes three stations, expects construction to begin in 2029 and service to start in 2032.

stories.title: Path Robotics is hiring for more than 50 Columbus roles in physical AI
stories.summary: Path Robotics is hiring for more than 50 positions in Columbus across AI, robotics, engineering, sales, and operations. The company, which has grown to more than 300 employees, develops AI models that allow robots to autonomously perform complex manufacturing tasks, starting with welding.

stories.title: Eighty Tesla Owners Face Prosecution for Hacking Their Cars to Unlock Full Self-Driving
stories.summary: South Korean police referred 80 Tesla owners to prosecutors for using unauthorized devices to activate Full Self-Driving (FSD) on vehicles not approved for the feature. The investigation uncovered hardware imported from overseas or assembled by owners to bypass regional software restrictions, with police warning that such modifications pose safety risks.

stories.title: Lessons from Japan and China after the Urda train tragedy
stories.summary: Japan's high-speed rail systems automatically activate emergency brakes if signaling fails, a fail-safe design that has prevented passenger deaths from collisions or derailments since 1964. China, which operates the world's largest high-speed rail network of over 50,000 kilometers, deploys 56,000 cameras and AI algorithms to monitor tracks and detect intruders or extreme weather.

stories.title: Uber plans $10bn investment in robotaxi expansion by 2028
stories.summary: Uber plans to spend $10 billion by the end of 2027 to expand its driverless car network, aiming to deploy 12,000 vehicles across 20 countries. The company expects to have 700 robotaxis on the road by the end of 2026, with around half of the initial 2,000-vehicle fleet allocated to the US market.

stories.title: From plumbers to Hasselhoff: railway operators and digital platforms remain divided over European ticketing rules
stories.summary: Railway operators and digital platforms debated commission rates and ticket regulation at a side conference during InnoTrans, hosted by Trainline. While stakeholders clashed over the need for mandatory rules, panellists agreed that buying cross-border tickets must become simpler.

stories.title: Agility is the first pure humanoid robot company on the stock market. Are you buying?
stories.summary: Agility will become a publicly-traded company through a reverse-merger with a special purpose acquisition company, raising $465 million in new capital. The company has $300 million in planned contracts for its new Digit 5 robot from 30 customers, with prototypes to be demonstrated at CES 2027.

also.title: Humanoid robot manufacturer Agility goes public on NASDAQ
Humanoid robot maker Agility Robotics debuts on the Nasdaq after SPAC merger
Nvidia-Backed Agility Robotics Goes Public at $2.5B in Humanoid Robot Milestone
Agility Robotics Starts Nasdaq Trading After Churchill SPAC Merger
How did Agility Robotics perform on its first day on the stock market?
First U.S. Humanoid Robot Stock Rings Listing Bell Today, Valued at Approximately $2.5 Billion

stories.title: Flock Drone Chief Sidhu Quits for a16z, Alpha Still in Early Access
stories.summary: Rahul Sidhu, Flock Safety’s chief strategy officer, is leaving to join Andreessen Horowitz’s American Dynamism team as an entrepreneur-in-residence. He departs with Flock’s Alpha drone still in early access, despite a promise to deliver units to customers before the end of 2025.

stories.title: Pentagon CTO: U.S. was not prepared for drone warfare
PODCAST: How Aureum Mobility and Figurr are planning vertiports for Canadian communities
Ukraine creates electronic warfare shield over Kyiv against remotely controlled Shahed drones
stories.summary: Ukraine carried out a large-scale electronic warfare operation to protect Kyiv against Russian Shahed drones equipped with remote-control capabilities, according to Serhii Beskrestnov, an adviser to the Ukrainian president on defence technology. The operation involved creating a protective electronic warfare “cylinder” over the capital to disrupt Mesh radio communications between Russian operators and the drones.

stories.title: Connecting technology and promoting cooperation in railway and infrastructure development.
stories.summary: The Organizing Committee of Rail&Cons Industry Week 2026 announced the event will run from November 11-13, 2026, at Hall 4, Vietnam Exhibition Center (VEC), Dong Anh, Hanoi. The program features conferences, technology exhibitions, and business networking to connect stakeholders and enhance the localization capacity of Vietnam's railway supply chain.

stories.title: Indian Railways’ freight growth speeds up to 8.3% year over year in October
stories.summary: Indian Railways loaded 145.07 million tonnes of freight in October 2026, an 8.32% year-over-year increase that the Ministry of Railways describes as the best October on record. The ministry attributed higher domestic coal volumes to increased power plant requirements, with coal deliveries averaging 469.8 rakes a day, up 19.5% from the prior year.

stories.title: Pottstown Passenger Rail Plan Advances With $654,000 in State Grants
stories.summary: The Schuylkill River Passenger Rail Authority voted unanimously Oct. 26 to spend two state grants totaling $654,000 on operational simulations led by Amtrak. The simulations will assess line capacity and upgrade costs, with Norfolk Southern and SEPTA coordinating the work.

stories.title: Focusing on Passenger Boarding and Alighting Safety, CaoCao Mobility Explores New Trusted Operation Pathways for Chinese Robotaxi Companies
stories.summary: CaoCao Mobility’s AI Innovation Center launched a research project on October 21 to develop trusted decision-making methods for robotaxi passenger boarding and alighting. Turing Award laureate Professor Joseph Sifakis, the center’s Chief Scientific Advisor, witnessed the launch. The project aims to create reusable verification methods for robotaxi safety in different cities and overseas markets.

stories.title: MBDA and Terma develop containerised air defence system with counter-drone capability
stories.summary: MBDA and Terma are developing the Self Protection Integrated Mistral 3 Module (SPIMM), a containerised air and surface defence system designed to protect naval vessels, offshore installations, and land-based sites against uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS). The system combines MBDA’s SIMBAD-RC4 weapon system with Terma’s C2 system and can be deployed on vessels without existing combat systems or relocated between ships and land-based sites.

stories.title: Ukraine expands private-sector role in counter-drone defence
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Cabinet of Ministers approved six changes to its experimental private air-defence programme, allowing companies to protect other businesses’ facilities under contract and transfer assets with the Air Force Command. The rules also permit crewed aircraft in private groups and regulate interceptor drone warheads, with nearly 100 companies having destroyed more than 60 aerial targets by mid-October.

stories.title: AirSight adds drone detection analytics to AirGuard platform
stories.summary: AirSight introduced new analytics capabilities for radio frequency (RF) detections in its AirGuard drone detection platform, enabling security teams to identify recurring drone activity and investigate individual flights.

stories.title: IRGC Captures US' Iran-Inspired 'Shahed Drone'; High-End American Tech Secret On Lucas Exposed
stories.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy claims its electronic-warfare forces seized control of two US-made LUCAS attack drones near the Strait of Hormuz and brought them down intact. Tehran is displaying the captured aircraft as spoils of war, while the US military has not confirmed the latest Iranian claims.

stories.title: Ukraine: Russian drone and missile attack sparks fire in Kyiv region
stories.summary: A Russian strike on a logistics facility in Sofiivska Borshchahivka, in the Kyiv region, injured one man and sparked a major fire following an overnight attack involving 128 drones and two missiles.

stories.title: Germany Approves Heron TP Drone Armament, Eurofighter Radar Upgrades among Other Projects
stories.summary: Germany's Bundestag Budget Committee approved six defense-funded military procurement projects on November 4, including Heron TP drone armament and Eurofighter radar upgrades. The committee authorized improved radar processors for German-Spanish E-Scan Mk1 AESA systems and portable troposcatter communications to strengthen the Tactical Wide Area Network Land-Based Operations.

stories.title: Uber robotaxi insurance: Mutua's reported Madrid pilot
stories.summary: Mutua Madrileña insures 20 vehicles in the Uber–WeRide robotaxi pilot in Madrid, with a safety operator aboard during the initial phase. The insurer says the pilot should help it assess risk and suitable insurance models.

stories.title: Sphere earns highest BARS Gold rating for drone safety
stories.summary: Australian drone operator Sphere achieved Gold status under the Flight Safety Foundation’s Basic Aviation Risk Standard (BARS) program, earning the highest designation available to remotely piloted aircraft system (RPAS) operators. The company also received the program’s BVLOS Operational Category endorsement, recognizing its approval to conduct beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) operations.

stories.title: India's First Indigenous Bullet Train Takes Shape At BEML's Bengaluru Facility, Designed To Carry 557 Passengers At 249 Kmph
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited detailed the specifications of India's first indigenously manufactured bullet train, which is under development at BEML's Bengaluru facility for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor. The eight-coach trainset is designed to carry 557 passengers at a planned operational speed of 249 kmph and a maximum test speed of 280 kmph.

stories.title: Turkey plans railway along its eastern Black Sea coast
stories.summary: Turkey's Ministry of Transport & Infrastructure initiated development of a 500 km main line railway along the eastern Black Sea coast between Samsun and the border with Georgia.

stories.title: Uzbekistan moves to expand civilian drone use, develop local production
stories.summary: Uzbekistan plans to expand civilian drone use, develop domestic production, and introduce a unified digital system to regulate operations, following a presentation reviewed by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on November 4. The proposals include establishing unified rules for drone operations, registration, and flight coordination, as well as introducing specialized training programs at the Transport University from the next academic year.

stories.title: Unitree founder sees next year as 'critical turning point' for robot industry
stories.summary: Wang Xingxing, founder of Unitree, forecast that next year will mark a critical turning point for the robot industry, stating that robots will soon handle diverse tasks in unfamiliar environments. He noted that precision tasks remain a challenge, with robots currently lagging behind humans in factory productivity.

stories.title: Neros Gives Pentagon A Small Stake With No Vote, Then Asks Who Buys
stories.summary: Neros Technologies says the Pentagon is acquiring a small, non-voting stake in the company in exchange for a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million signed on November 2. The loan, combined with $165 million in Neros equity, funds the production of motors, electronics, sensors, and batteries at the company's Torrance, California facility.

also.title: Pentagon Loans $450 Million to Unmanned Aircraft Systems Developer Neros
China makes 100 drones for every 1 built in US as Pentagon scrambles to catch up
Defense Department signs conditional loan commitment to develop small, unmanned aircraft systems

stories.title: Navy unfairly evaluated Saildrone MUSV proposal, court finds
stories.summary: The US Court of Federal Claims ruled that the Navy unfairly evaluated Saildrone's proposal for the medium unmanned surface vessel program, ordering the service to reevaluate the bid within 60 days. The court barred the Navy from spending more than $1.5 billion of the $2.1 billion allocated for production until the reevaluation is complete.

stories.title: Jimmy's World: FAA Says My Human Drone Is Illegal, Batteries Included
stories.summary: The FAA told Jimmy’s World host Jimmy that his YiVTOL S-Zero Plus is illegal because its batteries count toward the 254-pound empty weight limit, its remote-control mode classifies it as a drone, and Part 103 bars flight over congested areas.

stories.title: Turkey Tested a "Drone Hive" Based on the Bayraktar TB2
stories.summary: The Turkish company Baykar tested a new configuration of the Bayraktar TB2 drone that can be used as a carrier for FPV drones. During the test on November 4, the aircraft delivered the drones to a designated area and launched two of them at ground targets.

stories.title: The Hidden Data Challenges for Autonomous Trucking Safety
stories.summary: Empiric Earth is developing a framework called Apex to serve as a safety benchmark for autonomous vehicles, scoring systems on rare, dangerous scenarios rather than average driving conditions. The company, formed this year from the merger of Nexar and Nauto, has collected roughly 10 billion miles of driving data to identify edge cases like wildlife crossings and unique traffic signals.

stories.title: 8 Inches of Rain Shut Down Busiest US Rail Line for 60 Hours
stories.summary: BNSF’s Southern Transcon was shut down for roughly 60 hours after record flooding in New Mexico, while a nearly 30-hour technology outage paralyzed CSX operations in the East. Laguna, N.M., received 8 inches of rain over three days, triggering the closure beginning Saturday, Oct. 24, and running through that Tuesday.

stories.title: Wing Told Manchester "No Photos." Its Privacy Policy Says Otherwise
stories.summary: Wing and Walmart pitched drone delivery to the Manchester, Missouri, Board of Aldermen, but Mayor Benjamin Toben said no drones will deliver in the city this year. Wing representatives told aldermen the aircraft are “equipped for delivery only…No photos or live video feed,” yet Wing’s privacy policy lists “low-resolution overhead photos” among collected information.

stories.title: Amazon's Next Westborough Drone Plan Needs a New Zoning Ruling
stories.summary: Westborough’s building commissioner withdrew the August 26 zoning ruling that classified Amazon’s Prime Air drone pad as an accessory use of its 64 Otis Street warehouse, stating that any revised proposal will need a new zoning review. Amazon requested to withdraw its site-plan application without prejudice on October 30, and the town’s Zoning Board of Appeals continued the residents’ appeal without ruling on its merits.

stories.title: St. Louis Clears Police Drones 4-1. Camera Pledge Lives in an FAQ
Intermodal leads weekly gains as US rail traffic rises 3.5%, says AAR
stories.summary: The Association of American Railroads reported that U.S. rail traffic increased 3.5% in the week ending Oct. 31, with intermodal volume rising 3.9% and carload traffic up 3.0%. Through the first 43 weeks of 2026, total U.S. rail traffic has increased 3.8% year-over-year.

stories.title: Four DARPA robotic ground vehicles hunted for targets on their own in a live-fire event at Fort Knox, then held fire until a human approved each engagement
stories.summary: DARPA demonstrated four autonomous ground vehicles from its RACER program at the St. Vith Range at Fort Knox, Ky., on Oct. 15, where they searched for targets and waited for a human to approve a simulated rocket strike. The event, requested by U.S. European Command, marked a first for the team in moving from satellite imagery to tactical ground engagement.

stories.title: Exedy Wants $1,000 for a Spot in Line for Its Michigan Spray Drone
stories.summary: Exedy Drones opened reservations on Monday for the Ayre CX, an agricultural spray drone it plans to assemble in Van Buren Township, Michigan, with first deliveries targeted for spring 2027. Farmers and spray operators place a $1,000 reservation through an authorized Exedy dealer to claim one of the first 500 production positions, which the company calls the Founders Series.

stories.title: Naval Group unveils new drone carrier concept
stories.summary: French shipbuilder Naval Group unveiled an 8,000-ton drone carrier concept at the Euronaval defense show in Paris. The blueprint-stage vessel, designed to deploy surface, aerial, and underwater drones, measures 170 meters in length and carries a crew of 150.

stories.title: DJI Docks Put Tatra Rescuers Over Poland's Highest Peak in 6 Minutes
stories.summary: TOPR, the volunteer rescue service for Poland’s Tatra Mountains, finished a six-month test of three DJI Dock 3 stations and one DJI Dock 4. The docks allow a drone pilot at headquarters in Zakopane to launch from Morskie Oko and reach Rysy, Poland’s highest peak, six minutes later.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Emergency Service Receives Termit 2.0 Ground Robot
stories.summary: Ukraine’s State Emergency Service (DSNS) received a Termit 2.0 ground robotic complex named “Marsupilami” on Wednesday, Nov. 4, which can carry up to 500 kilograms (1,120 pounds) of vital cargo to hazardous areas. The donation, supported by the Serhii Prytula Charity Foundation and INSCIENCE, aims to preserve human lives as Russian forces increasingly target rescuers with “double-tap” strikes.

stories.title: Drone attacks in Black Sea pose new challenges to Bulgarian border police, in photos
stories.summary: Bulgarian border police crews rescued all 15 crew members from the Ukraine-operated cargo ship Chelsea 3 after it was hit by three drones near Sozopol. Over 24 days in October, nine cargo ships and tankers were struck by aerial or naval drones near the Bulgarian and Romanian coastlines, killing or leaving missing at least 30 sailors.

stories.title: Pano AI Launches Drone Partner Program to Connect Wildfire Detection, Real Time Operating Picture, and Aerial Response
stories.summary: Pano AI launched its Drone Partner Program at the Red Sky Summit, connecting drone and autonomous aircraft systems to its Rapid Detection platform. The program launches with four inaugural partners—Seneca, Rain, BRINC, and Censys Technologies—so a verified wildfire detection can coordinate the effective dispatch of aerial response to both suppression and increase situational awareness.

also.title: Pano AI Fire Cameras Can Now Alert Seneca and BRINC Drones to Smoke

stories.title: Stoneridge, Kodiak Integrate MirrorEye on Autonomous Trucks Cnder FMCSA Exemption
stories.summary: Stoneridge and Kodiak AI announced a collaboration to install MirrorEye camera monitor systems on Kodiak Driver-equipped trucks, replacing conventional mirrors. The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) renewed the exemption allowing this configuration in 2024 for five years, enabling Kodiak to design future SensorPods without traditional mirrors.

stories.title: Fire Commanders Can See Drone Locations and Live Video in One Place with New Skydio Partnership
stories.summary: Tablet Command and Skydio unveiled a proof of concept that allows incident commanders to view drone locations and live video feeds within a single screen. The companies are finalizing the production infrastructure, with the Louisville Fire Department serving as the initial customer.

stories.title: France Orders Development of UCUV Combat Underwater Drone
stories.summary: France contracted Naval Group on November 3 to build an experimental UCUV combat underwater drone, with sea trials scheduled for 2028. The platform must exceed 10 meters in length and 10 metric tons in weight, and will use the Steeris autonomous decision-making system to operate without constant remote control.

also.title: France Orders Naval Group to Develop Unmanned Underwater Combat Vehicle for Its Navy
UCUV underwater drone: Naval Group risks losing its lead without appropriate funding

stories.title: Kyiv's EW dome can't stop all drone attacks: Expert explains why
stories.summary: Aviation expert Anatolii Khrapchynskyi says electronic warfare over Kyiv cannot replace physically shooting down drones and is only one layer of air defense. He notes that when navigation channels are jammed, a drone is not destroyed but merely loses accuracy, and that 50 or 100 kilograms of explosives traveling at high speed will continue moving due to inertia.

stories.title: GE Aerospace Partners With BETA Technologies on World’s First Hybrid Electric Assisted Takeoff of a Commercial Aircraft
stories.summary: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies completed the world’s first hybrid electric assisted takeoff of a commercial aircraft using a modified Saab 340B at BETA’s flight test facility in Plattsburgh, New York. The test combined a traditional GE Aerospace CT7 gas engine with a modified hybrid electric engine, achieving takeoff with less noise compared to gas engines alone.

stories.title: Amazon Drones Reach Dolton. The Village Sends Residents to the FAA
stories.summary: Amazon’s MK30 delivery drones are flying over Dolton, Illinois, and village officials have begun telling residents to take their concerns to Amazon or the Federal Aviation Administration, CBS Chicago reported on Monday, November 2. Dolton is the second south suburb in a week to send residents elsewhere.

stories.title: Aformic Raises $6.95M Seed to Expand Autonomous Industrial Robotics
stories.summary: Aformic announced on November 4, 2026, that it raised a $6.95 million seed round led by Veteran Ventures Capital to expand its autonomous industrial robotics business. The financing will fund engineering and sales growth, further development of its Qursor software, and new hardware applications, including AI data center construction and maintenance.

stories.title: DRPM-UxS Delivers 25,000+ Autonomous, Counter-UAS Systems to CENTCOM
stories.summary: The Department of War announced that DRPM-UxS delivered a surge of combat-ready unmanned systems and counter-drone capabilities to U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) through an investment of approximately $782 million this year. DRPM-UxS will sustain continuous deliveries to CENTCOM while expanding fielding pipelines to Pacific Command, European Command, and the broader Joint Force.

also.title: Pentagon deploys 25,000 drone systems in Middle East for 2026 amid Iran tensions
U.S. Deploys 25,000+ Drone Systems Across CENTCOM as Unmanned Systems Spending Tops $6 Billion This Year
Centcom Benefits From Project Agincourt, Drone Dominance Efforts
Pentagon Delivers Over 25,000 Drones, Counter-Drone Systems to CENTCOM
CENTCOM Receives 25,000+ Drones and Counter-UAS Systems Under Pentagon Push

stories.title: Shield AI cofounder teases ‘snowball’ of X-BAT fighter drone announcements in Europe
stories.summary: Shield AI cofounder Ryan Tseng said a “snowball of activities” covering European orders and regional partnership agreements for the X-BAT fighter jet drone are set to be announced “soon.” The company is involved in “several active” sales campaigns across the continent, with a per-aircraft cost that could be brought down to $25 million.

stories.title: Robotics Startup Radar 2026
stories.summary: The Robot Report released its second annual Startup Radar, featuring 60 companies developing commercial robotics and related technologies. The report highlights organizations no more than five years old that are working on enabling technologies, new full systems, or novel business approaches across industries including manufacturing, agriculture, and healthcare.

stories.title: Skyfly Raises $10 Million For Personal eVTOL Certification
stories.summary: Skyfly Technologies closed a $10 million seed funding round led by HICO Investment Group to fund FAA light-sport aircraft certification of its Axe eVTOL under MOSAIC regulations. The capital will also expand production capacity in the United Kingdom and the United States ahead of planned customer deliveries in 2027.

stories.title: Henderson Police Push to Make Drone First Responders a Permanent Fixture
stories.summary: Henderson police are moving to keep drones flying as a permanent part of how the department responds to emergencies, after a 30-day demonstration found the unmanned aircraft often beat patrol officers to the scene. City officials say the Drone as First Responder program would give officers a real-time view of an incident before they ever arrive, helping them make faster, smarter and safer decisions once they do.

also.title: Henderson Moves to Make Public Safety Drone Program Permanent After Successful Trial

stories.title: Iran says it shot down US drone over Qeshm Island
stories.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed Wednesday that its air defenses shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. The US military did not comment on the claim.

stories.title: Threat from Belarus: Ukraine's border guards reveal details about drone signal repeaters
stories.summary: Andriy Demchenko, spokesperson for the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine, reported that no signal repeaters boosting Russian drone signals were detected operating in Belarus over the past week. He stated there is no concentration of hostile forces near the Ukrainian border, though Ukraine continues monitoring developments deep inside Belarusian territory.

stories.title: San Diego EV driver says he'd consider going back to gas as Waymo robotaxis crowd chargers
stories.summary: Waymo began official service in San Diego in September, and drivers reported waiting 30 minutes to an hour while multiple robotaxis occupied limited public chargers. The city plans to add chargers at more than 50 sites through an 18-month expansion effort.

stories.title: U.S. Army 101st Airborne Trains with Mobile 20-kW AMP-HEL Laser to Counter Drones at Southern Border
How GlobalLogic helped Haystack Robotics build a UV disinfection robot
stories.summary: GlobalLogic's Silicon & Embedded division helped Haystack Robotics engineer an autonomous mobile robot for hospital-grade UV disinfection. The platform features an expandable architecture and operates in autonomous or 'follow me' modes to navigate complex hospital environments.

stories.title: Saab Develops New Fully Autonomous CB 90 USV for the Swedish Navy
stories.summary: Saab is manufacturing the 18-meter CB 90 CX, a fully autonomous unmanned surface vessel for the Swedish Navy that features attack, air defense, and intelligence variants. Designed under the Battalion 2030 concept, the craft will operate without an onboard crew to support mobile coastal defense in the Baltic Sea.

stories.title: Hyundai Hydrogen City — Autonomous Robots Charge Hydrogen Vehicles 24/7
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor Group unveiled its hydrogen ecosystem at the World Hydrogen Expo 2026 in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, featuring the 25.5-ton New Xcient truck and the ACR-H autonomous charging robot. The group plans to apply this model to the Saemangeum AI Valley, an initiative involving an investment of approximately 9 trillion won to connect hydrogen production with AI data centers and robot manufacturing plants.

stories.title: Oslo helps strengthen defenses against Russian aerial attacks
stories.summary: Norway is helping Ukraine strengthen its air defenses against Russian attack drones and other aerial threats, including by expanding F-16 fighter jet capabilities and supporting the deployment of interceptor drones and anti-drone turrets, Ukraine's Defense Ministry said on Nov. 4.

stories.title: LiberAI Unveils Liber-0, a World Action Model That Grounds Human Experience in Robot Action
stories.summary: LiberAI introduced Liber-0, a world action model pretrained on more than 2.2 million hours of human experience to support zero-shot robot manipulation. The model achieved a 36.0% overall success rate in an evaluation of 60 tasks proposed by GPT-6 without using robot demonstrations collected specifically for those target tasks.

stories.title: Dronamics to Go Public on Nasdaq Through Merger
stories.summary: Dronamics Group Limited and GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. announced a definitive business combination agreement on November 4, 2026, valuing the cargo drone developer at $400 million. The deal targets $100 million in net cash proceeds to scale Black Swan production and launch U.S. operations, with closing expected in the first half of 2027.

also.title: Dronamics to Go Public Through Business Combination with GP-Act III Acquisition Corp

stories.title: US Air Force backs Joby’s autonomous cargo aircraft with $37M commitment
stories.summary: Joby Aviation secured additional US Air Force funding through AFWERX, bringing total commitments to nearly $37 million to support autonomy software development and Pacific testing. The Air Force also raised the maximum value of Joby’s autonomous logistics contract to $50 million, with work expected to continue until March 1, 2029.

also.title: Joby Expands Autonomous Flight Contracts with U.S. Air Force to Nearly $37 Million Following Record Coast-to-Coast Tour
Joby’s US Air Force Autonomy Contracts Reach Nearly $37m

stories.title: AirData and Pilot Institute Integration Automates Drone Pilot Training Records
stories.summary: AirData UAV and Pilot Institute announced an integration that automatically syncs pilot training records and skills into AirData. The feature, available on all subscription levels including free accounts, replaces manual certificate uploads with automatic badge imports and expiration reminders.

also.title: AirData can now automatically track drone pilot certifications and skills

stories.title: Joby Aviation Just Launched Florida Air Taxi Flights. Its November 4 Report Will Show What They Cost
‘Thinking Outside the Box’ – Ukraine’s Use of Battlefield Drones
stories.summary: Ukraine's Ministry of Defense announced on Oct. 28 that the 93rd Separate Mechanized Brigade's "Alter Ego" unit completed the first-ever combat mission by an amphibious unmanned ground vehicle, delivering supplies over a route exceeding 40 kilometers. The ministry reported bringing three amphibious UGVs into service to overcome water obstacles, with detailed specifications available on the Brave1 Market website for military orders.

also.title: Drones Push Sniper Rifles Aside in Ukraine Battlefield

stories.title: Estonian defence firms sought a €700 million drone shield deal without a public tender
stories.summary: A consortium led by Nortal sought a €700 million government contract to build a nationwide drone defence system without a competitive tender, but the defence ministry rejected the proposal amid concerns over procurement rules and political pressure.

stories.title: Ukrspetsdroneprom Unveils New "Chomga" Drone: Specifications and Combat Capabilities
stories.summary: Ukrspetsdroneprom unveiled the Chomga fixed-wing drone, a modular platform for reconnaissance and strike missions that costs between 5,000 and 7,000 dollars. The manufacturer stated the aircraft is fully airworthy and is currently in talks with military units for experimental combat operations.

also.title: Ukraine introduced the Chomga drone-uterus: the $5,000 aircraft can carry up to three FPV or interceptor drones

stories.title: Russia's First Hydrogen Train Is Taking Shape – New 380 kW Motor Enters Certification
stories.summary: TMH-Electrotech completed certification testing for the DTA-380A traction motor in October 2026, a critical component for Russia's first hydrogen-powered passenger train, designated 62-4584. The train, which accommodates 550 to 875 passengers, is scheduled to commence trials in 2027 before its planned deployment on Sakhalin Island.

also.title: First home-built hydrogen train with 435-mile range set to enter service in Russia

stories.title: Latvia Launches Interceptor Against Drone Incursion
stories.summary: Latvian forces launched a Blaze interceptor to track an unidentified drone that entered the country’s airspace on November 1, then activated its self-destruct mechanism to prevent it from crossing into Russia. The drone entered from Belarus at around 7 p.m. and flew through the Krāslava region toward the Russian border, crossing into Russia through the Ludza district at 7.16 p.m.

stories.title: Hospital train proposed for military evacuations and civilian disaster response
stories.summary: Siemens Mobility and Lufthansa Technik Defense agreed to jointly develop a train for cross-border military medical evacuations and civilian disaster response.

stories.title: FAA Adds Research Topics on Lost Communications and Spectrum Interference for Autonomous Airport Ground Vehicles
stories.summary: The FAA added research topics on lost communications and spectrum interference for autonomous ground vehicles in Amendment 013 to its Aviation Research 2025 Broad Agency Announcement, dated Nov. 3, 2026. The agency seeks methods to mitigate interference with airport equipment and define vehicle behavior during command-and-control outages, with research periods of no more than 12 months.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike sets fire to hub of e-retailer Ozon in southern Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine struck a logistics hub of Russian e-commerce group Ozon in Adygeysk on Nov 4, causing a fire and debris damage in two nearby villages without casualties. Ozon expects to lose 30.1 billion roubles from drone attacks across 11 sites and is temporarily not accepting deliveries at the affected center.

stories.title: A Russian drone with an unexploded 10-kg warhead was discovered in Kyiv
stories.summary: Bomb disposal experts defused a 10-kg unexploded warhead from a “Gerbera-2” drone found in the Desnyanskyi District of Kyiv. The munition was transported for disposal after a local resident reported the debris in a forest park area.

stories.title: The Scarcest Resource in Trusted Drone Supply Chains Is Time
stories.summary: AUVSI Interim President and CEO Heather Lee stated that time is the primary constraint for trusted drone supply chains, noting that rebuilding U.S. manufacturing capacity and reaching scale take years. She highlighted that Taiwan’s Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) became the first Green UAS assessment body outside the United States, conducting cybersecurity testing against the same requirements AUVSI applies in the U.S.

stories.title: Puente steps down as Spanish Transport Minister after announcing proposed safety measures
stories.summary: Spanish Transport Minister Óscar Puente resigned following the fatal train crash near Urda, having announced proposals to address safety and operational challenges across the high speed rail network.

also.title: Spain’s transportation minister steps down over train crash to try to save the Socialist campaign ahead of elections

stories.title: Bullet train beneath Chicken's Neck? India's Delhi-Guwahati rail plan faces a massive hurdle
stories.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma stated that the proposed Delhi-Guwahati bullet train may require tunnels or elevated tracks to cross the Chicken's Neck corridor, which narrows to 16 km in some stretches. He warned that this section could cost double or triple a normal high-speed rail stretch, with final route and technology decisions still pending.

stories.title: Ondas Secures Multi-Million-Dollar Counter-UAS Contracts in Europe and Asia, Accelerating Global Expansion in Aerial Defense
stories.summary: Ondas Inc. secured multi-million-dollar contracts with a major European police organization for portable Ranger Counter-UAS systems and an Asian governmental customer for Iron Drone autonomous interception systems. These agreements expand the company's global Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems business by providing mobile detection and physical drone neutralization capabilities to international defense and security agencies.

also.title: Ondas wins multi-million-dollar counter-drone contracts in Europe and Asia as global demand rises

stories.title: Norway deploys NASAMS to Russian border to spot stray drones
stories.summary: Norway’s air force deployed NASAMS air defense sensors to Kirkenes, near the Russian border, to detect drones that drift off course into Norwegian airspace, the Norwegian Ministry of Defense said. The ministry is also sending more than 30 soldiers to reinforce the Garrison of Sør-Varanger, the army unit that guards the 198-km (123-mile) border with Russia.

stories.title: Babcock signs Thales and Kraken for drone warship framework
stories.summary: Babcock announced at Euronaval that it is adding platforms, sensors, payloads, communications and mission systems to its ARMOR Force framework, building on existing work with HII and Arondite. The company stated its facilities at Rosyth and Devonport will support development, integration, simulation and testing, while offering navies a single point of accountability for technology integration and support.

also.title: Babcock Expands ARMOR Force Framework With Seven Autonomous Naval Technology Partners

stories.title: ZenaTech’s Drone as a Service Signs Nearly US$1 Million in Solar Construction Survey Contracts for a U.S. Utility with Potential for US$2.5 Million in Follow-On Revenue
stories.summary: ZenaTech won multiple bids for drone-based topographic surveys with an initial aggregate value of nearly US$1 million for a U.S. utility's solar infrastructure construction project. Management estimates the project could generate up to US$2.5 million in additional revenue over the next two years, contingent on successful execution and additional contract awards.

stories.title: Saronic launches second Marauder autonomous ship in Louisiana
Volatus Aerospace, Calian and Instrumar Sign Collaboration Agreement to Advance Smart Coating Technologies for Arctic Uncrewed Aircraft Systems
stories.summary: Volatus Aerospace, Calian, and Instrumar signed a one-year, non-binding memorandum of understanding to evaluate integrated ice detection and de-icing technologies for uncrewed aircraft systems. The collaboration aims to improve aircraft performance in Arctic environments by combining Volatus' operational expertise, Calian's electrically heated de-icing laminate, and Instrumar's icing detection capabilities.

stories.title: Saildrone expands its European market reach with manufacturing partner in Norway
stories.summary: Saildrone selected Norwegian naval builder Umoe Mandal to locally produce its Surveyor surveillance craft, aiming to expand sales in Northern Europe. Umoe Mandal plans to build a new production site near its main plant with an initial rate of at least two vessels per month, while Saildrone provides the autonomy suite and electronics.

Saildrone And Umoe Mandal Formalize Surveyor USV Production Deal At Euronaval

stories.title: Element to provide fleet management for Waymo in Toronto
stories.summary: Element Fleet Management will provide operational support for Waymo’s autonomous ride-hailing fleet in Toronto, maximizing vehicle availability. The two companies already work together in San Diego, and will join forces again in Canada when Waymo launches its service in Toronto, scheduled for 2028.

stories.title: Ukraine and the European Commission are negotiating a drone agreement
stories.summary: Oksana Osadcha, an adviser to the staff of Ukraine’s National Security and Defense Council, stated that Ukraine is currently negotiating a separate drone agreement with the European Commission. She clarified that the defense-industrial partnership signed during Ursula von der Leyen’s July 15 visit to Kyiv is not yet a distinct drone deal.

also.title: Ukraine and European Commission in talks on Drone Deal

stories.title: Video: Ukrainian FPV drone catches up to Russian motorized assault vehicle
stories.summary: A Ukrainian FPV drone attacked a Russian soldier riding a motorcycle, with the footage showing the drone approaching and the soldier looking into the camera before the video cuts off. The Ukrainian military reported eliminating 2,180 Russian occupiers as of November 4, 2026, and striking at least 30 strategic targets in Russia in October.

stories.title: South Korea Opens Humanoid Robot Data Factory to Train AI Models on Real-World Tasks
stories.summary: South Korea opened a humanoid robot data factory at the Korea Institute of Machinery and Materials (KIMM) on Nov. 3, using 12 robots to generate training data for autonomous AI models. The facility, developed with the Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute (ETRI), aims to reduce dependence on overseas datasets and will gradually open to domestic companies and universities beginning at the end of 2027.

stories.title: Uber beats Q3 2026 estimates, targets about 700 driverless vehicles by year-end
stories.summary: Uber reported third-quarter 2026 gross bookings of $59.82 billion and plans to operate approximately 700 fully driverless vehicles by year-end, scaling to more than 2,000 in 2027 using technology from partners Waymo and Rivian.

also.title: Uber Targets Over 2,000 Driverless Vehicles on Its Platform
Uber's Driverless Fleet Could Top 2,000 In 2027

stories.title: Look, no hands: Self-driving future comes to Switzerland
stories.summary: Passengers in Zurich's Furttal region can now book a self-driving electric car through a dedicated app as part of a pilot project called IAMO. Launched for public use on September 28, the service operates three Nissan Ariya electric cars equipped with cameras, laser scanners and sensors.

stories.title: GXO’s Humanoid Robots Are Getting More Warehouse Work
stories.summary: GXO and Agility Robotics will extend Digit humanoid robot deployments to Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee, beginning in early 2027. The expansion follows more than 100,000 tote movements at the Flowery Branch, Georgia facility, where Agility reported approximately 98% accuracy.

stories.title: Ukrainian Startup Helps Military Use Russia's Analog Drone Video to Its Advantage
stories.summary: Ukrainian startup CODE380 developed the D·Vision SDR drone detector, which taps into Russian analog video feeds to alert targeted soldiers. The system sweeps frequencies from 500MHz to 8,700MHz, allowing defenders to detect drones several kilometers out and update via software patches.

stories.title: Needle-nose X-59 jet just hit a major milestone in the quest to cut long-haul flight times in half
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 QueSST jet completed its first year in flight with 41 trips, including a recent move to the Kennedy Space Center. The experimental aircraft, part of a $630 million program, is designed to reduce sonic booms to a "glide thump," potentially enabling supersonic passenger flights in the continental US.

also.title: What you should know: NASA’s supersonic X-59 aircraft

stories.title: ApusNeo HAPS Completes 28-Hour High-Altitude UAS Flight Over European Airspace
stories.summary: UAVOS Inc. completed the first flight of the ApusNeo High Altitude Platform System in European airspace, reaching 14,500 meters and remaining airborne for 28 hours at Canarias Stratoport in Spain. The aircraft carried an Earth observation payload with optical and infrared sensors, transmitting data in real time while coordinating with ENAIRE, Spain’s air navigation manager.

stories.title: Sir Ed Davey joins calls for full electrification of rail line into Hull
stories.summary: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey joined calls for the government to electrify the railway line into Hull, arguing that the planned battery trains fail to honor a 2024 devolution deal. The Department for Transport announced a £1-billion investment in 29 new battery trains built by Alstom in Derby, which could arrive at Hull’s Paragon Station in 2034.

stories.title: Galaxy 1 and Viasat Expand Velaris Satellite Communications for Commercial UAV Operations
stories.summary: Galaxy 1 Communications and Viasat announced a production agreement to expand the commercial capabilities of Viasat’s Velaris satellite communications platform for unmanned aircraft systems. Following two years of joint development, the companies validated operational capabilities to transition the platform into production service delivery, supporting autonomous delivery drones, electric air taxis, and remote industrial inspections.

Galaxy 1 and Viasat Move UAV Connectivity Platform into Commercial Production

stories.title: A LOCUST laser drone defense system has been deployed near Trump's estate in Florida
stories.summary: NORAD and USNORTHCOM deployed ground-based air defense assets and counter-drone systems near Mar-a-Lago at the request of the U.S. Secret Service. The systems include a LOCUST laser anti-drone system and AN/TWQ-1 Avenger anti-aircraft missile systems.

also.title: Anti-drone laser spotted near Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate, media report

stories.title: ZAWYA: Ericsson brings drone detection capabilities to mobile networks
stories.summary: Ericsson introduced the Ericsson ISAC System, which adds drone detection capabilities to mobile networks by using 5G radios to track unconnected objects. Commercial pilots begin in 2027, with broader deployments starting in 2028.
